verdict.rationale: The evidence documents manual region selection for Vercel Functions: a default of iad1, configurable per project or per function, plus Enterprise failover regions. Nothing shows Vercel automatically placing compute near backend data, so manual region pinning is only an adjacent control, not the automatic placement the story asks for.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency

citations.quote: You can override regions for individual functions using the functions property in your project configuration.
